prompt:
The source text, verbatim:

MapleSure Advisor Portal - Secure Sign-In (New Application)                     
                                                                                
Business Objective                                                              
                                                                                
MapleSure's licensed group-benefits advisors have no online entry point of      
their own today: advisor interactions arrive by phone and email and are         
re-keyed by service staff into internal systems. The business wants a new,      
standalone Advisor Portal web application, delivered incrementally, whose       
first release is deliberately small: a secure sign-in page that establishes     
the application, its repository and its delivery pipeline, so later releases    
can add advisor-facing features on a foundation that already exists.            
                                                                                
Requirement Summary                                                             
                                                                                
This is a new application, not an enhancement to the existing Sponsor Portal    
or Claims API. Release 1 is limited to authentication surface only: a login     
page, a welcome landing page after successful sign-in, and sign-out. The        
implementation should stay simple and self-contained, using a local             
credential store seeded with demonstration accounts; integration with the       
enterprise identity provider is a later release.                                
                                                                                
Requirements                                                                    
                                                                                
1. The application must present a sign-in page with an email address field      
   and a password field, reachable at the application root.                     
                                                                                
2. The sign-in form must validate input before submission: both fields are      
   required, and the email address must be well-formed. Validation messages     
   must appear next to the field they concern.                                  
                                                                                
3. The password field must be masked by default and must provide a show/hide    
   toggle.                                                                      
                                                                                
4. Submitted credentials must be checked against a local credential store       
   seeded with demonstration advisor accounts; no external identity provider    
   is called in this release.                                                   
                                                                                
5. A failed sign-in must show a single generic error message that does not      
   reveal whether the email address or the password was incorrect.              
                                                                                
6. A successful sign-in must land the advisor on a welcome page that greets     
   them by name and shows a visible sign-out control.                           
                                                                                
7. Signing out must clear the session and return the advisor to the sign-in     
   page; the welcome page must not be reachable after sign-out.                 
                                                                                
Out of Scope for Release 1                                                      
                                                                                
Multi-factor authentication, self-service password reset, account lockout       
policies, and enterprise identity provider integration are explicitly out of    
scope and will be scheduled as later releases of the Advisor Portal.            
                                                                                
                                                                                
                                                                                
                                                                                
                                                                                
                                                                                
                                                                                
                                                                                
                                                                                
                                                                                
                                                                                

Extract the requirement from this text. Return JSON exactly matching:
{
  "epic_title": "<short title>",
  "business_objective": "<one paragraph>",
  "requirement_summary": "<short paragraph>",
  "extracted_requirements": [
    {"rule_id": "REQ-<n>", "text": "<requirement, in the source's own words>"}
  ]
}
